New JRV-AUD-004 tests had already produced three expected behavioral failures before the abort; no complete test count is assigned to this job.
impact: At least one full regression job aborted, reducing CI reliability. No conclusion about the installed application or target PC follows from this failure.

Complete regression suite on both Windows Python versions after a correction.
